description: This is a Java test class containing integration tests for OAuth2 resource server application, using Spring Boot and MockMvc to simulate HTTP requests with Bearer tokens.

classes.name: OAuth2ResourceServerApplicationITests
classes.description: A test class for OAuth2 resource server application, performing HTTP request tests with various Bearer tokens.

methods.name: performWhenValidBearerTokenThenAllows
methods.description: Tests that a valid Bearer token allows access to the root endpoint.

methods.name: performWhenValidBearerTokenThenScopedRequestsAlsoWork
methods.description: Tests that a scoped token can access the /message endpoint.

methods.name: performWhenInsufficientlyScopedBearerTokenThenDeniesScopedMethodAccess
methods.description: Tests that an insufficient scope token is denied access to the /message endpoint.

methods.name: performPostWhenValidBearerTokenThenScopedRequestsAlsoWork
methods.description: Tests that a write-scoped token can successfully POST to /message.

methods.name: performPostWhenInsufficientlyScopedBearerTokenThenDeniesScopedMethodAccess
methods.description: Tests that a read-only token cannot POST to /message.

methods.name: bearerToken
methods.description: Creates a RequestPostProcessor that adds a Bearer token header to mock requests.
